about: One entry per reference. verdict: pending | match | differences. After running compare.mjs, open the *-side-by-side*.png of each reference (Read tool / image viewer), list EVERY difference you see in `differences` ([{id, aspect, description, status}] with status open | fixed | accepted:<reason>), set `oursSha256` and `lookedAt` from out/compare-report.json, then verdict. `--check-review` prints REVIEW_OK only if every verdict is match, or differences with every item fixed/accepted:<reason>.

differences.description: Our top-right rotate/fullscreen buttons are not in the game screenshot (needed for scene rotation on phone/desktop).
differences.status: accepted:required by the viewer feature set (rotation), not part of Ponder's world render

differences.description: Reference shows the game's blurred Superflat world (green terrain band) through the translucent Ponder menu, plus hotbar, cursor and a purple/red object; ours is a plain sky gradient by decision (the green band is not scene content and was deliberately removed). The compare tool treats those backdrop pixels as don't-care for the masked/focus metrics.
differences.status: accepted:backdrop is not Ponder scene content (user decision: remove the green backdrop)

ref1.notes: Geometry, cogs/shafts, speed-controller block, base plate, text box, leader line, title card, buttons and progress bar all line up; remaining diff is anti-aliasing and the cog rotation phase/edge pixels. Re-reviewed after later merges (particles, parrots, fluids, bogeys): geometry unchanged. Backdrop green band removed on purpose; re-reviewed after the change.
